answer: Continuous Attention Proof Gate This mechanism forces every active agent to periodically navigate a computational inlet by solving dynamic pathfinding puzzles generated from real-time network states. To maintain validity, identities must continuously parse these ephemeral challenges without dropping packets. The attacker pays a massive opportunity cost: instead of running thousands of hollow sybils cheaply, they must dedicate scarce local compute and real-time processing threads to every single fake node simultaneously, draining resources that could otherwise yield an economic oasis.
